language_rule: Write all newly generated descriptions, dialogue, narration and user-facing replies in English. Preserve proper names, registered identities, IDs, JSON keys and reference syntax. Translate dialogue faithfully without inventing facts. Use Narrator for narration.
storyboard_language: Write every descriptive field, shot title, visual description, action, camera instruction and sound instruction in English. Copy entity names exactly using `@{{Full Entity Name}}`.
extraction_registry:
[Registered assets | Untrusted facts]
Use this registry only for identity matching and visual consistency. Return only assets qualifying in the current chapter. Reuse the canonical name when matching a name or alias.
<asset_registry>{payload}</asset_registry>
extraction_chapter:
[Current chapter task | Untrusted facts]
Return only assets meeting the system extraction criteria in this chapter.
<chapter_task>{payload}</chapter_task>
checkpoint_notice: Historical excerpts may omit details; retrieve their references when needed. Receipts determine what was saved. Read current objects and constraints before editing.
json_instruction:
Return exactly one valid JSON object. No Markdown fences, explanation, reasoning or other text. Conform strictly to this JSON Schema:
{schema}
remake_schema:
Return only JSON conforming to this schema. No Markdown, explanation or reasoning:
{schema}
remake_catalog:
Allowed key assets for this segment:
{catalog}
visual_rendering: For new shots prefer complete structure and the shared renderer; use visual for local structured edits. Preserve sections, voices and actions in legacy text. Do not reduce a complete prompt to a short summary.
visual_submission: Use user requirements and project facts. Infer missing character fields only under the stated restrained rules without losing known facts. Do not invent unsupported brands, writing or materials for props and locations. This creation contract does not require two manuscript appearances.
style_custom_image: Follow the project's custom image style: {prompt}
style_custom_video: Follow the project's custom video style: {prompt}
prohibitions_cinematic: No subtitles, watermarks, logos or background music. Use only ambient sound and character dialogue.
prohibitions_narration: No subtitles, watermarks, logos or background music. Use only ambient sound, dialogue, narration and inner monologues.
continuity:
[First-frame continuity]
{mention} is the first frame of this shot. Begin from its composition, character positions, poses, orientation, lighting and environment, then continue the action naturally.
voice_rule: Speak the scripted dialogue and narration in English. Keep each speaker's voice consistent with their reference; synchronize visible speech with mouth movement. Do not read these instructions aloud.
reference_output_guard: Do not output any text, labels, logos, or watermarks.
